_evidence: 0x0040cd00 parses a u16 stream at esi with lodsw: four words copied to 0x602098..0x6020a4, then a header word (0xffff = empty, 'cmp ax,-1; je 0x40cd89'), two words to 0x62d284/0x62d288, a first segment index (record 0x8943a0 + w*0x160), then up to 0x3b pairs (bx = lane byte word, ax = next segment index or 0xffff, which ends the list with ebp = [0x866ecc]). Segment indexes 0..25 are the ring records; 0xffff appears in about 1/8 of the words so every terminator position occurs. 250 of the 256 bytes are the longest possible read.
